title: The Fashion Disciples Heavyweight Obsidian Hoodie
description: Engineered from 520GSM combed organic loopback French terry in washed volcanic obsidian. Cut in an oversized relaxed drop-shoulder silhouette with double-layered hood and tonal architectural embroidery.

title: Tailored Double-Breasted Obsidian Trench Coat
description: Double-breasted trench crafted from heavyweight Italian wool-blend gabardine in deep midnight obsidian black. Features a structured storm flap, horn buckles, and deep side welt pockets.

title: Matte Asphalt Quilted Funnel Puffer Jacket
description: Water-repellent technical ripstop shell stuffed with sustainably sourced 700-fill down alternative. Features a high insulated funnel neck, storm cuffs, and matte gunmetal zipper hardware.

title: Chalk Off-White Chunky Ribbed Knit Sweater
description: Chunky architectural knit spun from 100% Australian merino wool in chalk ivory and charcoal blend. Features dropped shoulders, thick mock-neck collar, and clean structured drape.

title: Pleated Wide-Leg Studio Trouser in Jet Black
description: Tailored double-pleated relaxed trousers in deep volcanic jet black. High-waisted drape with discreet elastic back waistband and tailored cuff break.

title: Vintage Washed Box Tee - Obsidian Monogram
description: Heavy 280GSM ring-spun cotton tee with mineral charcoal wash. Finished with subtle distressed collar edge, wide boxy sleeves, and blind-stitched hem.
